articles.title: In Colombia's Roadless Jungles, Traditional Midwives Are a Lifeline—But They Want Respect
articles.summary: Deep in Colombia's Pacific rainforest, where hospitals are days away, traditional midwives deliver thousands of babies. But they say the medical system discriminates against them. Now, they're pushing for collaboration, not replacement.

articles.title: New York Primary Upends Democratic Establishment: Three Socialist-Backed Candidates Win
articles.summary: In a stunning primary night, three democratic socialist candidates backed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani defeated incumbents and establishment picks in New York. The wins signal growing voter appetite for leftist policies—and a potential rift in the Democratic Party.

articles.title: In Exile and Banned from Competing, Afghan Women's Cricket Team Finds a Royal Ally
articles.summary: King Charles met the Afghan women's cricket team in London, offering symbolic support to players who fled the Taliban and cannot represent their country. The team sees the meeting as a chance to speak up for all Afghan women denied the right to play sports.
